strategies.name: Trend pullback
strategies.desc: In an uptrend (price > EMA50 > EMA200), buy when price dips to EMA20 and closes back above. Mirror for shorts.

strategies.name: 20-day breakout
strategies.desc: Buy a close above the 20-day high when above EMA200; sell a close below the 20-day low when below EMA200.

strategies.name: RSI(2) dip buy
strategies.desc: In a long-term uptrend, buy a sharp short-term dip (RSI(2) < 5). Mirror for shorts.

strategies.name: Bollinger squeeze
strategies.desc: After a very quiet period (narrow bands), trade the breakout close outside the bands.

strategies.name: MACD trend cross
strategies.desc: MACD crosses its signal line in the direction of the EMA200 trend.

strategies.name: Inside-bar breakout
strategies.desc: After an inside day, trade the close beyond its high/low in the trend direction.
